scope: Focused static review of the frozen plan and final one-curl executor. No acquisition, source-body reread, preprocessing, estimator, controller, or source modification performed by this reviewer.

scientific_materiality.reason: The exact raw source supplies provider-documented GRCh37 additive beta/SE and alleleB coding. It avoids the Catalog GRCh38 coordinate/hm_code lineage currently untested by the unmatched prefixes; a complete verified raw source permits a separately reviewed result-free full-source/common-SNP QC decision.
scientific_materiality.not_a_new_release: Known Catalog delivery metadata are dated 2025; newly useful to this project, not a newly released independent study.
scientific_materiality.source_only_h2_feasibility: Potential next scientific question; UNKNOWN_NOT_TESTED and not admitted by this review.
scientific_materiality.clinical_event_window_and_controls: UNKNOWN. These constrain construct interpretation and transport; they do not prevent acquisition of this exact existing clinical ICD-coded source.
scientific_materiality.per_variant_N: all_total is supplied total N, not certified per-variant case/control effective N. Exact semantics and any allowed approximation are downstream preprocessing/model gates; no population-total substitution admitted.
scientific_materiality.cohort_independence: GERA-only source identity is documented. Individual enrollment/relative intersections with discovery and any future outcome cohort are not certified. No independent both-trait replication follows.

transport_and_resource_checks.TLS: Verified HTTPS only; no insecure option or redirect/retry option; default curl configuration disabled
transport_and_resource_checks.one_request: One source URL and one owned curl process; no automatic retry, second request, or resume launched
transport_and_resource_checks.etag_verification: Header-name case ignored; opaque ETag value retained and matched exactly. No weak ETag matches the expected strong value.
transport_and_resource_checks.source_acceptance: Successful curl exit, HTTP200, exact 2019290168 bytes, exact ETag and Content-Length, published MD5 match, local SHA256, unchanged plan, fsync, and verified non-clobbering publication
transport_and_resource_checks.deadline_scope: One monotonic deadline covers transfer, per-1MiB digest verification and pre-publication guard. These are software-observed guards, not a hard real-time or kernel memory certificate.
transport_and_resource_checks.curl_RSS_qualification: Observed ps samples, with owned-child termination on a sampled guard breach; sub-interval peak RSS is not certified.
transport_and_resource_checks.native_floor_policy: 3 GiB unchanged and not waived. Acquisition-only internal floor is distinct from native admission.
transport_and_resource_checks.checkpoint_protection: Refuse existing final, part, receipt or private transport evidence; reserve own part with exclusive xb; mv -n publication verified by absence of owned part and presence of final
transport_and_resource_checks.failure_protection: Stop monitored owned curl in finally on monitor exception or guard; keep its checkpoint and failure evidence. No automatic resume or overwrite.
transport_and_resource_checks.later_resume: NOT_ADMITTED. Requires separately checked same source ETag/length and HTTP206 Content-Range beginning at exact checkpoint length.
transport_and_resource_checks.raw_body_destination: SSD private source directory only; no variant rows exported to review, repository or public artifact

corrected_findings.correction: Quoted If-Match, common transfer/verification deadline, exclusive checkpoint and non-clobbering publication are present in reviewed final script.
Fixed curl executable with first-argument --disable; ETag value case preserved; monitored owned-child try/except/finally cleanup now present.

checkpoint_census: Prior metadata-only census of the new and V8 SSD source_review directories found no GERA full/part/checkpoint. Scope is those directories, not all SSD. The executor repeats refusal checks immediately before transfer.
unclosed_downstream_gates: Full-source row counts, parse/completeness, finite supplied beta/SE, INFO/MAF, allele and chromosome/coordinate validity remain NOT_TESTED.
rs_id_all is provider coordinate/allele identifier, not guaranteed dbSNP rsID; GRCh37 HM3 coordinate/allele mapping and reference eligibility require separate admission.
Total-N versus case/control effective-N semantics and allowed source-specific assumptions require separate model review; cases3972/controls52665 are design metadata only.
Clinical event count/window/control exclusion and phenotype transport remain unresolved; no UKB symptom/chronic insomnia equivalence is inferred.
Ancestry-appropriate LD/reference, retained common-SNP coverage, h2/SE/intercept and estimator precision remain untested.
No participant independence, new association, disease pair, biology or replication certificate is created.
